title: Farsports 2026 NEW EVO C Series Disc Brake Wheels
notes: Official store, prices shown in USD. Specification image: EVO C6 58.5 mm height, 31.5 mm outer and 24 mm inner width front and rear; Alpina Ultralite steel spokes 21 front / 24 rear (2:1); Farsports CHO1F/CHO1R ratchet hubs, Center Lock; 120 kg weight limit without a stated scope; 1,380 g ±5%. Text: tubeless-ready hooked rim, 12x100/12x142 mm axles. Full EVO6 C sets were US$1,459 with steel bearings and US$1,659 with CeramicSpeed bearings for all five freehub options. The product page says shipping includes taxes with free shipping to select countries; 14-day returns at the buyer's expense. No tire range is published. Photo: the EVO6 pair from the official gallery.
